schema.name: ganglior.node-export
schema.doc: PpgDex PPG-derived events → Ganglior bus. t/tMs = floating wall-clock ms (UTC getters). null = unknown, never fabricated.

reserved.doc: Awaiting other fleet nodes; null until available.

evidence.envelopeReason: no acquisition envelope joins the PPG path — the capture-host envelope keys on the O2Ring .dat session_id; PpgDex reads the _PPG.txt stream
evidence.inputReason: contentId unavailable (SignalFrame not co-loaded, or no NN train)

hr.uncertaintyReason: not estimated — this node carries no uncertainty model for whole-record HRV summaries (the device-PPI cross-check in `validation` is a comparison, not an interval)
hr.codeReason: no bundle identity passed (headless source-module run) — the app reads <html data-manifest-hash/data-compute-hash> and passes opts.code; the regen tool passes the shipped bundle’s

evidence.inputReason: contentId unavailable (SignalFrame not co-loaded, or no NN train)

rmssd.uncertaintyReason: not estimated — this node carries no uncertainty model for whole-record HRV summaries (the device-PPI cross-check in `validation` is a comparison, not an interval)
rmssd.codeReason: no bundle identity passed (headless source-module run) — the app reads <html data-manifest-hash/data-compute-hash> and passes opts.code; the regen tool passes the shipped bundle’s

channelStability.scope: per-channel detector NOISE (independent residual only); says nothing about whether all three channels are reading the correct waveform feature

time.windowNote: sdnn/rmssd are whole-record (single-site PPG); per-5-min values live in epochs[]. Directly comparable to another node’s wholeRecord SDNN/RMSSD.
time.sdnnNote: whole-record sdnn runs high on optical — SDANN/baseline-wander inflation the chest ECG does not carry. sdnnIndex (mean of per-5-min SDNN) and sdnnRobust (quality-gated MEDIAN of per-5-min SDNN) both remove it, sdnnRobust the most; use sdnnRobust for cross-node SDNN comparison. Bias magnitudes are deliberately not quoted here: the earlier figures came from a single paired night and did not reproduce on the multi-night corpus.

confidence.note: 0..1 per-metric confidence from measured drivers (motion→hf, posture/baseline→vlf/sdnn, coverage+correction→beat-to-beat). vlf capped 0.7 — single-site optical VLF stays baseline-wander-limited even when clean; not a defect to "fix". A metric is null when its driver was NOT MEASURED (see `evidence`): a session with no accelerometer has no motion-graded hf, and publishing one would be a grade resting on nothing.

apnea.cvhrMethod: CVHR events/h from finger PPI NN (Hayano apnea-band 20–45 s; ports ECGDex detectCVHR)

timeseries.doc: 5-min epochs — primary cross-node feed (posture rides on epochs[].position).

ppi.doc: Per-beat PPI from the SELF-COMPUTED optical spine (3-LED consensus → buildPPI → Malik correctRR) — the device _PPI.txt is often header-only and its _HR.txt all-zero, so this is the ONLY interval series for this sensor, not a second opinion. `spine` names which fiducial won (foot or peak). tSec[i] is the beat time in seconds from startEpochMs; ms[i] is the interval ENDING at that beat. Beat times are EXPLICIT, never reconstructed by cumulative sum — a dropout would otherwise be closed silently and every later beat shifted.
